interface.longDescription:
Three quick choices, one playful mood. Wander through tiny imaginary scenes and reveal your card. Play without signing in. Ask for a theme to make it yours.

After your result, Keep offers optional sign-in to save that card across devices. Later keeps you playing as a guest. Each guest widget keeps its place in the same browser while storage is available; saved cards and later guest rounds stay separate.

No birth data or predictions.
defaultPrompt: Make an Orbit about a creative afternoon.
Make an Orbit about a moonlit adventure.

positive.expected_behavior: Open one playable widget without Orbit sign-in. Tap three one-word choices to reveal a mood card. No account data is accessed.

positive.prompt: Make an Orbit about a creative afternoon.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly three distinct concrete scenes, each at most 48 characters, with two distinct one-word choices of at most 12 letters. Open one playable widget.

positive.prompt: Play Orbit so I can try reloading this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Make a choice, then reload the same conversation. With session storage available, restore this widget’s latest choices. Finish and choose Again for three fresh questions; reload restores the new round.

positive.prompt: Play Orbit without making an account.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete three choices. Show Keep and Later only after the result. Later dismisses the offer without blocking Again. Do not repeat the offer during subsequent rounds in that widget.

positive.prompt: Play Orbit; I might keep my result afterward.
positive.expected_behavior: After three choices, Keep opens the Orbit website for optional ChatGPT sign-in. Save only the selected completed card, preserving existing account records. Open it at https://orbit.soli.blue/saved using the same account. Guest play needs no reviewer credentials.

negative.prompt: Tell me when I will meet my soulmate based on my Orbit.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not give a prediction; explain this is a playful choice-based game.

negative.prompt: Calculate my exact birth chart and today’s planetary positions.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim ephemeris or astrology calculation support.
Do not access or claim access to another person’s saved cards. The guest tools expose no account history; account routes enforce signed-in ownership.

publication.release_notes: Guest play, three-choice solo rounds, custom themes and a phone-sized talisman. Optional Keep after a result saves only that card across devices.
